_about: Airbus AC A319 (Jul 01/26), 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions, Sharklet sheet 3 (page index 43): layers.py --mode strokes-in-fill at scale 20 with --xscale 1.0249, clip 135,165,460,272 (side). The sheet is drawn 2.5% short lengthwise against its printed 33.84 m and 11.04 m (the height matches the A320's sheet): --xscale evens it out. The A320's points (a320/) moved by the A319's shorter fuselage (2.13 m, 4 frames, ahead of the wing; 1.60 m, 3 frames, ahead of the aft door) onto this sheet, then snapped. Pixels of that raster, line centres. Groups then laid on this sheet by their best fit lengthwise (fin -78 px, engine +58, sharklet +128; plan: wing +92, tailplane -12): the A319 sheet places them a little differently from the plugs alone.
